lines.en: label tsuneyoslumber2:
scene unexpecteddate1
: Where have you taken me?
lines.zh: : 你把我带到哪儿来了？

lines.en: : Out of all of the stereotypical first date locations, I figured an amusement park would carry the lowest probability of us touching one another.
lines.zh: : 在所有老套的初次约会地点里，我觉得游乐园能让我们俩碰到彼此的概率最低。

lines.en: : My only condition is that Io can never know that this happened.
lines.zh: : 我唯一的条件是，Io 永远不能知道这件事。

lines.en: : My only condition is that Noodles can never know that this happened. He has been begging me to come here ever since it opened.
lines.zh: : 我唯一的条件是，Noodles 永远不能知道这件事。自从这里开业，它就一直缠着我带它来。

lines.en: scene unexpecteddate2
: How do you even know about this place? You’re the one who’s supposed to be oblivious to basically anything you haven’t grown up with.
lines.zh: : 你到底是怎么知道这个地方的？按理说，凡是不是你从小接触的东西，你应该一概不知才对。

lines.en: : That is nonsense. I am a hip and trendy girl who keeps up with the times. And you are nothing more than a bean sprout who sat at the bottom of the bag for too long.
lines.zh: : 胡说八道。我可是紧跟潮流的时髦女孩。而你不过是在袋底放太久的豆芽。

lines.en: : What does that even mean?
lines.zh: : 那到底是什么意思？

lines.en: : That you are a moist and unappetizing bacterial sponge. I can’t believe I agreed to go on a date with you.
lines.zh: : 意思是你是块又湿又没食欲的细菌海绵。真不敢相信我居然答应和你约会。

lines.en: : This was literally your idea.
lines.zh: : 这明明是你自己提的。

lines.en: scene unexpecteddate3
: I have no idea what you are talking about. But I suppose that, since we are here, we should find a way to pass the time.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你在说什么。不过既然来了，我想我们该找点事打发时间。

lines.en: : Are there any rides that you would like to go on? You should be tall enough to access all of them.
lines.zh: : 有什么游乐设施你想玩的吗？你的身高应该都够格了。

lines.en: : We can do whatever you want. I don’t really care one way or the other.
lines.zh: : 你想做什么都行。我无所谓。

lines.en: : That puts us in quite the predicament then as I am afraid of amusement park rides.
lines.zh: : 那我们就陷入僵局了，因为我害怕游乐园的游乐设施。

lines.en: scene unexpecteddate4
: Then why would we-
lines.zh: : 那我们为什么还——

lines.en: : There are a surprising amount of people here for a weekday, wouldn’t you agree?
lines.zh: : 工作日居然有这么多人，你不觉得意外吗？

lines.en: : I...have no-
lines.zh: : 我……不知道——

lines.en: : Please stand at least five feet away from me at all times so none of them think that we are physically involved. You are ruining my reputation.
lines.zh: : 请任何时候都与我保持至少五英尺的距离，免得他们以为我们有身体上的牵扯。你在毁我的名声。

lines.en: scene unexpecteddate5
: I don’t like date-Tsuneyo. She’s confusing. And that’s saying a lot since normal Tsuneyo is an enigma rivaling even the most mysterious...mysteries of the universe.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢约会儿模式下的 Tsuneyo。她让人摸不着头脑。鉴于平时的 Tsuneyo 就已经是个足以匹敌宇宙中最神秘……之谜的谜团，这话的分量可不轻。

lines.en: : Which, fortunately, allows me to segue into the reason I wanted to talk to you today. You-
lines.zh: : 幸好，这让我能顺势切入今天想跟你谈的事。你——

lines.en: : Can we not ignore your motivations for the time being and focus simply on enjoying ourselves? If I wanted to fret over the mysterious mysteries of the universe, I would just microwave a banana.
lines.zh: : 我们能不能暂时把你的动机放一边，专心享受当下？如果我想为宇宙中那些神秘的谜团烦心，我大可以去微波一根香蕉。

lines.en: : What does that even-
lines.zh: : 那到底是什么意思——

lines.en: : There must be something that two people who are afraid of amusement park rides should be able to do at an amusement park.
lines.zh: : 两个都怕游乐设施的人，在游乐园里总该有能做的事吧。

lines.en: : I never said I was afraid. I’d be fine with riding something so long as you-
lines.zh: : 我从没说过我害怕。只要你陪我，坐什么我都行——

lines.en: scene unexpecteddate6

: It’s okay. I won’t think any less of you if you just tell the truth. It’s a shame, though. I was really looking forward to riding the most thrilling, fast-paced attractions this place has to offer. Oh well.
lines.zh: : 没关系。你只要说实话，我不会因此看轻你。不过真遗憾，我本来很期待去坐这里最刺激、最快速的设施呢。唉，算了。

lines.en: : Oh, look. Food.
lines.zh: : 哦，看。吃的。

lines.en: scene unexpecteddate7
Tsuneyo wanders off and I retract any fleeting thoughts I may have had earlier about a future where the two of us grow close.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 走开了，我收回之前那些关于我们俩未来会亲近的转瞬即逝的念头。

lines.en: This is not a life I want to live.
lines.zh: 这不是我想要的人生。

lines.en: And should a moment arise today that does not involve me being strung along, I should thank her for showing me that and saving me from what would surely be an exhausting alternate universe.
lines.zh: 如果今天出现了哪个不牵着我鼻子走的瞬间，我倒该谢谢她让我看清这一点，把我从那个必定令人精疲力竭的平行宇宙里救了出来。

lines.en: : Oh, I forgot my wallet.
lines.zh: : 哦，我忘带钱包了。

lines.en: : THEN NO TAKOYAKI FOR YOU!
lines.spk: Takoyaki Son, Son of Takoyaki Man
lines.zh: : 那你就别想吃章鱼烧了！

lines.en: : Please wait one moment. My husband will take care of the bill.
lines.zh: : 请稍等一下。我丈夫会来付账。

lines.en: : HE BETTER! I WENT THROUGH SO MUCH TROUBLE TO MAKE YOU THESE!
lines.spk: Takoyaki Son, Son of Takoyaki Man
lines.zh: : 他最好付！我费了这么大劲才给你做好这些！

lines.en: : I understand. But any minute now, he will show up and everything will be okay.
lines.zh: : 我明白。不过他马上就会出现，一切都会没事的。

lines.en: : Any minute now.
lines.zh: : 马上就到。

lines.en: : Please wait one moment.
lines.zh: : 请稍等一下。

lines.en: scene unexpecteddate8
: What are you doing? I gave you the signal.
lines.zh: : 你在干什么？我都给你使眼色了。

lines.en: : Oh, my bad. I didn’t realize we were married. I must have missed the ceremony.
lines.zh: : 哦，我的错。我不知道我们结婚了。我一定是错过了婚礼。

lines.en: : You did, but I will forgive you in exchange for money. I require immediate assistance. The octopus salesman is becoming unruly.
lines.zh: : 你确实错过了，但只要你出钱，我就原谅你。我需要立刻支援。那个卖章鱼的越来越不像话了。

lines.en: : You should probably make sure you have cash on you before trying to buy something next time.
lines.zh: : 下次想买东西之前，你最好先确认自己身上带了现金。

lines.en: : Marrying you was clearly a mistake. I deserve to be valued just as much as anyone else.
lines.zh: : 嫁给你显然是个错误。我理应得到和别人一样的重视。

lines.en: scene unexpecteddate7
: This is my husband. He will pay for me.
lines.zh: : 这是我丈夫。他会替我付钱。

lines.en: : AIN’T HE A LITTLE TOO OLD FOR YOU?!
lines.spk: Takoyaki Son, Son of Takoyaki Man
lines.zh: : 他对你来说是不是太老了点？！

lines.en: : Do not project your beliefs onto us. We are in love and in dire need of oversized octopus balls.
lines.zh: : 别把你的观念强加给我们。我们真心相爱，而且急需超大份章鱼丸子。

lines.en: : STOP LYING TO ME! GET AWAY FROM MY STALL!
lines.spk: Takoyaki Son, Son of Takoyaki Man
lines.zh: : 少跟我撒谎！滚出我的摊子！

lines.en: : You just wait until my husband hears you raising your voice at me.
lines.zh: : 你等着，等我丈夫听见你冲我大吼大叫。

lines.en: scene black
scene unexpecteddate9
: Are you happy now?
lines.zh: : 你现在满意了？

lines.en: : I would be happier if I was not just yelled at. What an unpleasant man.
lines.zh: : 如果没被人大吼一通，我会更满意。那个男人真讨厌。

lines.en: : I also don’t understand why he had to arrange this dish in such an obscene manner. I feel rather uncomfortable eating it.
lines.zh: : 我也不明白他为什么非要把这道菜摆成这么下流的样子。吃它让我浑身不自在。

lines.en: : Eat it quickly. There are children here.
lines.zh: : 快点吃。这里还有小孩呢。

lines.en: scene unexpecteddate10
: I have an idea.
lines.zh: : 我有个主意。

lines.en: : That’s nice. Keep it to yourself.
lines.zh: : 真好。就憋在心里吧。

lines.en: : I refuse as I can not imagine any other way that we will be able to drag this day out longer.
lines.zh: : 我拒绝，因为我想不出还有什么别的办法能把这一天拖得更长。

lines.en: : Then let’s call it quits. I liked the idea of giving it a shot earlier, but this is clearly not working.
lines.zh: : 那就到此为止吧。刚才我还挺想试一试的，但显然行不通。

lines.en: : That is because we have been going about things all wrong and you are too cowardly to ride the rollercoasters with me.
lines.zh: : 那是因为我们从头到尾的做法都错了，而且你太胆小，不敢陪我坐过山车。

lines.en: : Yup. You got me.
lines.zh: : 对。你说对了。

lines.en: : Thank you for admitting it. That must have taken a lot of courage. But you do not need to fear any longer, for my new idea involves nothing but eating for the rest of the afternoon. And then the night.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你能承认。那一定花了不少勇气。不过你不用再害怕了，因为我的新主意里只有一件事：接下来的整个下午，然后是整个晚上，都用来吃。

lines.en: : You go ahead but I highly doubt I can continuously eat for the next eight or nine hours.
lines.zh: : 那你请便，不过我很怀疑自己能不能连续吃上八九个小时。

lines.en: : Not with that attitude, you can’t.
lines.zh: : 就你这态度，肯定不行。

lines.en: : I doubt you can either. You’ve barely even touched your titjobyaki.
lines.zh: : 我看你也够呛。你那份“奶子烧”都没怎么动。

lines.en: scene unexpecteddate11
: This will make an excellent anecdote if I am ever allowed to perform stand-up comedy again.
lines.zh: : 如果哪天我又能上台讲单口喜剧了，这绝对是个绝佳的段子。

lines.en: : Yeah...I think it would be best for everyone if you explore other options for the time being.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我觉得目前对你和大家来说，最好还是探索点别的出路。

lines.en: : Excellent idea. Let us go eat something slightly less sexual in nature. I am not yet prepared for this.
lines.zh: : 好主意。我们去吃点没那么色情的东西吧。我还没做好心理准备。

lines.en: : I spent 2,000 yen on that. You are going to-
lines.zh: : 那玩意儿我花了一千……不是，两千日元。你这是要——

lines.en: scene unexpecteddate12
: Oh no. I seem to have dropped it. What a terrible accident.
lines.zh: : 哦不。我好像把它掉了。真是一场可怕的意外。

lines.en: : YOU FUCKING WHORE! I HOPE YOU DIE!
lines.spk: Takoyaki Son, Son of Takoyaki Man
lines.zh: : 你这该死的婊子！我希望你不得好死！

lines.en: scene unexpecteddate13
: Hey. Don’t say that about my wife.
lines.zh: : 嘿。别这么说我的妻子。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Sir. Would you like another serving?
lines.spk: Takoyaki Son, Son of Takoyaki Man
lines.zh: : 对不起，先生。您还要再来一份吗？

lines.en: : No thanks. We’ll be taking our business elsewhere.
lines.zh: : 不用了，谢谢。我们去别家消费。

lines.en: scene unexpecteddate14
: Right, Tsuneyo?
lines.zh: : 对吧，Tsuneyo？

lines.en: : {i}Ahem...{/i}
: That’s...right.
lines.zh: : 是……没错。

lines.en: scene unexpecteddate15
: Come, H...Husband. We will now begin the second phase of our food tour.
lines.zh: : 来吧，老……老公。我们的美食之旅现在进入第二阶段。

lines.en: Did Tsuneyo...actually get a little flustered just now?
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 刚才……是真的有点慌了？

lines.en: Should I be doing nice things for the girls more often?...
lines.zh: 我是不是该多为这些女孩做点好事？……

lines.en: scene unexpecteddate16
: Ahhhh! I did it again, Frank! Why do I always have to get so nervous around pretty girls?!
lines.spk: Takoyaki Son, Son of Takoyaki Man
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！我又搞砸了，Frank！为什么我一碰到漂亮女孩就总是这么紧张？！

lines.en: : Don’t cry, man. You’ll figure it one day. You’ve just gotta keep at it.
lines.spk: Frank: Friend of Takoyaki Son, Son of Takoyaki Man
lines.zh: : 别哭啊，兄弟。总有一天你会搞定的。你只要坚持下去就行。

lines.en: : My dad will never love me at this rate! I’m nothing but a disappointment! I should have been a painter!
lines.spk: Takoyaki Son, Son of Takoyaki Man
lines.zh: : 这样下去我爸永远不会爱我！我就是个让人失望的东西！我当初该去当画家的！

lines.en: : Don’t say that, buddy. I think you’re great.
lines.spk: Frank: Friend of Takoyaki Son, Son of Takoyaki Man
lines.zh: : 别这么说，哥们儿。我觉得你很棒。

lines.en: : You don’t understand! I could’ve had class! I could’ve been a contender! I could’ve been somebody! Instead of a bum...which is what I am. Let’s face it...
lines.spk: Takoyaki Son, Son of Takoyaki Man
lines.zh: : 你不懂！我本来可以有格调的！我本来可以是个竞争者！我本来能成为一个人物！而不是现在这个……废物。面对现实吧……

lines.en: : Hey, here’s an idea. How about we hit up the strip club after this? Chances are it’ll be pretty empty since we somehow managed to dodge the draft. Will that cheer you up, pal?
lines.spk: Frank: Friend of Takoyaki Son, Son of Takoyaki Man
lines.zh: : 嘿，我有个主意。待会儿我们去脱衣舞俱乐部怎么样？既然我们不知怎么躲过了征兵，那儿大概会很空。这能让你开心点吗，老兄？

lines.en: : ...Maybe.
lines.spk: Takoyaki Son, Son of Takoyaki Man
lines.zh: : ……也许吧。

lines.en: scene black
: Or maybe I’ll just fuck that up too!
lines.spk: Takoyaki Son, Son of Takoyaki Man
lines.zh: : 或者我大概也会把那事搞砸！

lines.en: scene unexpecteddate17
The second phase of our apparent food tour takes us to a booth specializing in yakitori which, of course, I wind up paying for as well on account of my date being entirely useless.
lines.zh: 我们这场所谓的美食之旅的第二站，是一家专卖烤鸡肉串的摊子，当然也是我付的钱，因为我的约会对象完全派不上用场。

lines.en: : Simple, yet enticing...and grilled to perfection. You can tell just how much care and experience was poured into making these.
lines.zh: : 简单，却诱人……而且烤得恰到好处。你能看出做这些时倾注了多少心血和经验。

lines.en: : Can you? Because we haven’t even eaten any yet.
lines.zh: : 你看得出来吗？我们还没吃呢。

lines.en: : The first step of eating happens with one’s eyes. That’s why many shops have dishes set up in window-displays.
lines.zh: : 吃的第一步是用眼睛看的。所以很多店家才会把菜品摆在橱窗里。

lines.en: : Sure, but...that’s still not actually {i}eating.{/i} Like, no one passes by a window and thinks, “I’m full now. Time to go home.”
lines.zh: : 话是没错，可……那终究不是真的{i}在吃{/i}。没人路过一个橱窗就会想，“我饱了。该回家了。”

lines.en: scene unexpecteddate18
: Do you think it might be advantageous if Tojo Ramen were to incorporate such a display? Are you more likely to stop in somewhere if you can see what they have to offer first?
lines.zh: : 你觉得如果 Tojo Ramen 也搞这么一个展示柜，会不会有好处？能先看到店家提供什么，你是不是更可能走进去？

lines.en: : I guess, but...could you even afford that? Your shop doesn’t have any windows and it’s not like you get a lot of foot traffic either.
lines.zh: : 大概吧，不过……你们负担得起吗？你们店连窗户都没有，而且人流也不多。

lines.en: scene unexpecteddate19
: I suppose that is true. I’m just not sure what else a business can do when it falls into the same predicament my family’s store is in.
lines.zh: : 我想确实如此。当一家店落入和我家店一样的困境时，我真不知道还能做些什么。

lines.en: : There are many steps you can take to revitalize a dying business, but it becomes significantly harder when the business is only dying due to its location’s population thinning out.
lines.zh: : 重振一家垂死的生意有很多办法，但当这家店只是因为所在地的人口在流失而垂死时，难度就大了。

lines.en: : With winter on the brink of returning, I have some hope for a change in fortune. But I’d be foolish to not worry of what may happen if I am not so lucky.
lines.zh: : 眼看冬天又要回来，我对时来运转还抱着些许希望。但如果运气不好，我要是不担心会发生什么，那就是愚蠢。

lines.en: : I think the only option at that point would be to move the store elsewhere, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我想到了那个地步，唯一的选择就是把店搬到别处去，不是吗？

lines.en: scene unexpecteddate20
: It’s true that such a feat may help. And I understand that inheriting the family business means that I will need to make certain changes in order to adapt to the times.
lines.zh: : 这种壮举或许确实有帮助。我也明白，继承家业意味着我必须做出某些改变来适应时代。

lines.en: : But Tojo Ramen is more than just a small, windowless ramen shop. It is a gateway to the past...a means of transporting people back to when things were simpler.
lines.zh: : 但 Tojo Ramen 不只是一间小小的、没有窗户的拉面店。它是一道通往过去的门……一种把人送回那个万事都更简单的年代的方式。

lines.en: : Before franchises with diminishing standards...or misguided restaurants that care more about turning a profit than providing a quality product.
lines.zh: : 在那些标准不断下滑的连锁店出现之前……在那些比起提供优质产品、更在乎赚钱的误入歧途的餐厅出现之前。

lines.en: : Would you not be able to...do all that somewhere else?
lines.zh: : 你就不能……在别的地方做到这些吗？

lines.en: : It wouldn’t be the same.
lines.zh: : 那就不一样了。

lines.en: : Tojo Ramen is my home. My entire life had taken place there until recently. Abandoning it in pursuit of something newer would feel like abandoning a piece of myself.
lines.zh: : Tojo Ramen 就是我的家。直到不久前，我的人生全部都在那里发生。为了追求更新的东西而抛弃它，感觉就像抛弃了一部分的自己。

lines.en: : Not to mention the toll it would take on my father. I’m not sure he could survive a move in his current condition.
lines.zh: : 更别提对我父亲的打击了。以他现在的状况，我不确定他能不能熬过一次搬迁。

lines.en: : Well, not to be morbid...but you know he won’t be around forever, right?
lines.zh: : 好吧，不是我说话难听……但你知道他不可能永远陪着你吧？

lines.en: : I have come to accept that, yes. But it does not mean I am comfortable with it or...unworried of its potential consequences.
lines.zh: : 是的，我已经接受了。但这不代表我对此感到自在，也不代表……我不担心它可能带来的后果。

lines.en: : I’m simply unsure of my capability to make such a substantial change. It would be more like starting over than repairing what I currently have.
lines.zh: : 我只是不确定自己有没有能力做出这么大的改变。那更像是重新开始，而不是修缮我现有的东西。

lines.en: : Then I guess it comes down to whether or not you believe what you have can even be repaired in the first place. Sounds like that’s what you have to figure out before you worry about moving or anything.
lines.zh: : 那我想，归根结底要看你相不相信你现有的东西还能修。听起来在考虑搬迁什么的之前，你得先把这个想清楚。

lines.en: : I know that. But any time such a thought crosses my mind, I become too sad to think properly.
lines.zh: : 我知道。但每次这个念头掠过脑海，我就难过得没法正常思考。

lines.en: : It seems to be a never-ending cycle.
lines.zh: : 看起来这是个无止境的循环。

lines.en: scene unexpecteddate21
: Cycle- right. I need your help with something. I-
lines.zh: : 循环——对了。我需要你帮个忙。我——

lines.en: : Do you think there is anywhere here that sells noodles? I grow weary of these noodle-free dishes and know exactly what it is that will cheer me up.
lines.zh: : 你觉得这里有没有卖面条的地方？我已经厌倦了这些没有面条的食物，而且我极其清楚什么能让我开心起来。

lines.en: : I mean...I’m sure there’s somewhere. But I need to talk to you about-
lines.zh: : 我是说……肯定有地方卖。但我得跟你谈——

lines.en: scene unexpecteddate22
: I apologize, but I am unfit for talking to until my mind is cleansed. Please accompany me in pursuit of the world’s greatest starch.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，在我心灵得到净化之前，我不适合交谈。请陪我去追寻世界上最伟大的淀粉吧。

lines.en: scene black
That’s several times today that Tsuneyo has changed topics without giving me the chance to explain why I came looking for her in the first place.
lines.zh: 这已经是今天 Tsuneyo 第好几次转移话题了，我根本没机会解释自己最初为什么来找她。

lines.en: It’s not a good omen for things to come at this point...which is upsetting since I was really beginning to believe that she might be onto something after what she said on the beach.
lines.zh: 在这个节骨眼上，这对往后可不是什么好兆头……这让人沮丧，因为在她于海滩上说过那些话之后，我真的开始相信她可能察觉到了什么。

lines.en: But I guess her connection or...understanding or whatever it is concerning the nature of these cycles is not as strong as Yumi’s.
lines.zh: 但我想，她对这种循环本质的连接……或者说理解，也许不像 Yumi 那么强。

lines.en: Tsuneyo was never directly affected like she was. She just kind of...accidentally picked up on things?
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 从未像她那样被直接影响过。她只是……不小心察觉到了一些东西？

lines.en: Maybe that’s not enough to go off of.
lines.zh: 也许光凭这点还不够。

lines.en: Maybe it was just a coincidence that she felt something like that, but-
lines.zh: 也许她有那种感觉只是巧合，可是——

lines.en: : One, please. My husband will pay.
lines.zh: : 一份，谢谢。我丈夫付钱。

lines.en: But...
lines.zh: 可是……

lines.en: I feel like I can’t give up yet.
lines.zh: 我觉得自己还不能放弃。

lines.en: Because even if this date has been equal parts confusing and exhausting, I’m enticed by the idea of a future where the Tsuneyo {i}I{/i} know is by my side.
lines.zh: 因为就算这场约会既让人摸不着头脑又累人，我还是被那个未来吸引着——一个有{i}我{/i}认识的 Tsuneyo 陪在身边的未来。

lines.en: And she becomes a little less real once parts of her start being stripped away.
lines.zh: 而一旦她身上的某些部分开始被剥离，她就变得不那么真实了。

lines.en: scene unexpecteddate23
It’s been six hours since we’ve gotten here...and we’ve done nothing but walk around and eat.
lines.zh: 我们到这里已经六个小时了……除了四处走和吃，什么也没做。

lines.en: And talk, of course...but that’s a natural side effect of just being in the presence of one another.
lines.zh: 当然也聊天……但那只是两个人待在一起自然会有的副作用。

lines.en: I have tried on countless occasions to explain to Tsuneyo that those thoughts she had about the repetitiveness of time are not without merit, but she has not heard me even once.
lines.zh: 我试过无数次向 Tsuneyo 解释，她关于时间不断重复的想法并非全无道理，可她一次也没听进去。

lines.en: And I have given up on trying.
lines.zh: 而我放弃了尝试。

lines.en: I didn’t think I would. And while I’m no stranger to giving up, it’s not as if I approach every obstacle in my path without at least some interest in clearing it.
lines.zh: 我本以为自己不会放弃。虽然我对放弃并不陌生，但我也从不会在跨越障碍时，连一丝清除它的兴趣都没有。

lines.en: But there comes a time when you need to accept you’re fighting a losing battle...and it’s hard to win any battle at all when you’re not even sure who or what you’re fighting against.
lines.zh: 可总有个时刻，你得承认自己在打一场必败的仗……而当你连自己在跟谁、跟什么作战都不确定时，任何仗都难赢。

lines.en: I’m sure there’s a Tsuneyo out there who {i}will{/i} come to understand that the world is not what it seems.
lines.zh: 我相信某个世界里存在一个{i}终会{/i}明白世界并非表面那样的 Tsuneyo。

lines.en: But this one isn’t it.
lines.zh: 但眼前这个不是。

lines.en: And that makes everything feel so...inauthentic.
lines.zh: 而这让一切都显得那么……不真实。

lines.en: : How strange. Up until now, I believed there was no limit to the amount of noodle-based dishes I could consume...but I am struggling to so much as touch this plate.
lines.zh: : 真奇怪。直到刚才，我都以为自己能吃的面条类料理没有上限……可我现在连碰一下这盘都费劲。

lines.en: : It’s okay to give up, you know. I was actually just thinking that.
lines.zh: : 放弃也没关系的，你知道吧。我刚才还在想这个。

lines.en: : I refuse. Someone made this dish and it is my duty as a fellow warrior to slay it. If you or anyone else had ever left behind something that I took the time to make for you, I would never forget it.
lines.zh: : 我拒绝。有人做了这道菜，而作为同为战士的我，有义务斩杀它。如果你或任何别人把我花时间为你做的东西剩下来，我绝对不会忘记。

lines.en: : I have a confession to make.
lines.zh: : 我要坦白一件事。

lines.en: : I hope it is not a romantic one. I am in no shape to love right now.
lines.zh: : 希望不是浪漫的坦白。我现在这副状态没法爱人。

lines.en: : The last time I had you box up the remainder of my food at Tojo Ramen, I never wound up finishing it when I got home.
lines.zh: : 上次在 Tojo Ramen 让你帮我把剩菜打包，我回家后根本没吃完。

lines.en: : You bastard. How dare you.
lines.zh: : 你这混蛋。你怎么敢。

lines.en: : It’s the truth.
lines.zh: : 这是实话。

lines.en: : It is insulting enough that you would have me pack the remainder of your food, but to spit in my face and tell me you did it for nothing more than recreation is horrible by even your standards.
lines.zh: : 让我替你打包剩菜，这已经够侮辱的了；你再往我脸上啐一口，说你这么做纯粹是为了好玩，就连你的标准来说也恶劣透顶。

lines.en: : Do you know what else is horrible?
lines.zh: : 你知道还有什么恶劣吗？

lines.en: : Spiders. They’re second only to you on my list right now.
lines.zh: : 蜘蛛。在我现在的榜单上，它们仅次于你。

lines.en: : No, hold on. I was about to say something really smooth.
lines.zh: : 不，等等。我刚要说一句特别撩人的话。

lines.en: : I apologize. Please try again.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。请再来一次。

lines.en: : Do you know what else is horrible?
lines.zh: : 你知道还有什么恶劣吗？

lines.en: : Spiders. They-
lines.zh: : 蜘蛛。它们——

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, come on.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，拜托。

lines.en: : Fine. One more time. And I will keep my mouth shut even if I {i}do{/i} have an immense distaste for arachnids.
lines.zh: : 好吧。最后一次。就算我对蛛形纲动物{i}深恶痛绝{/i}，这次我也会闭嘴。

lines.en: : Then...do you know what else is horrible?
lines.zh: : 那么……你知道还有什么恶劣吗？

lines.en: : That this day has to end.
lines.zh: : 这一天必须结束。

lines.en: : That would have been very endearing if you were not currently my least favorite creature in the entire world.
lines.zh: : 如果你不是眼下我在整个世界最讨厌的生物，这句话会非常打动人。

lines.en: : I try.
lines.zh: : 我尽力了。

lines.en: : It doesn’t have to end yet, though.
lines.zh: : 不过它还不一定要结束。

lines.en: : It kind of does. The park is closing. So unless you plan on coming back to my house with me, I can’t see how-
lines.zh: : 差不多该结束了。乐园要关门了。所以除非你打算跟我回我家，我看不出——

lines.en: scene unexpecteddate24
: That.
lines.zh: : 那个。

lines.en: : The ferris wheel? What about it?
lines.zh: : 摩天轮？它怎么了？

lines.en: : Do you think we could make it in time if we ran?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我们现在跑过去还来得及吗？

lines.en: : It’s slow enough that the two of us would be able to ride it without fear. And I would be lying if I said I was not slightly interested.
lines.zh: : 它慢到我们俩坐上去也不会害怕。而且如果说我一点也不感兴趣，那是在撒谎。

lines.en: : Are you sure you want to?
lines.zh: : 你确定想坐？

lines.en: : Is there a reason we should not?
lines.zh: : 有什么理由不该坐吗？

lines.en: : You’d be trapped in a slow moving, compact box with me for an extended period of time. Aren’t you worried I’ll try something?
lines.zh: : 你会和我一起被关在一个缓慢移动的狭小箱子里很长一段时间。你不怕我对你做点什么？

lines.en: scene unexpecteddate25
: Are you not worried of what {i}I{/i} could do to you? You may be larger, but I firmly believe that I would come out victorious in the event of a battle.
lines.zh: : 你就不怕{i}我{/i}能对你做什么吗？你也许块头更大，但我坚信一旦打起来，赢的人会是我。

lines.en: : I’m ashamed to say it, but I think you probably would as well.
lines.zh: : 说起来惭愧，但我也觉得大概会是你赢。

lines.en: : Then let’s go. If we delay any further, we’ll miss our chance...
lines.zh: : 那我们走吧。再耽搁下去就来不及了……

lines.en: : And this may be the last date we ever have.
lines.zh: : 而且这也许是我们最后一次约会了。

lines.en: : Does that upset you?
lines.zh: : 这让你难过吗？

lines.en: : I’m not sure.
lines.zh: : 我不确定。

lines.en: scene black
: Neither am I.
lines.zh: : 我也不确定。

lines.en: : Fortunately, the ride moves slowly.
lines.zh: : 所幸，这玩意儿走得很慢。

lines.en: : We’ll have a long while to think about it.
lines.zh: : 我们有很长的时间去想这件事。
